topic_source: inferred theme (no explicit topic recorded in round_topic.json); per memory/archivist/topic-evolution.md
why_now: Cycle 13 over-scoped to ~70 goals and collapsed to 1.4% completion, so cycle 14 deliberately shrank scope to a small focused verification/audit set (~10 goals) to restore quality-over-quantity.
builds_on: It builds on the sensing + action layers from cycles 9-13 (forecasts, health scores, model swap, re-routing) by adding the audit pass that confirms those systems actually behave correctly (cockpit regression, idempotency).
enables: Its 84.8% completion (24h, 1 intervention) re-established a reliable high-completion baseline and gave the fleet the verification foundation cycle 15 needed to trust automated mode transitions.

topic_source: explicit (round_topic.json current; first explicit convergence topic per memory/archivist/topic-evolution.md)
why_now: With the action loop closed in cycles 10-14 and a stable high-completion baseline (C14: 84.8%), cycle 15 was the first to make convergence an explicit topic - because the fleet could now track its OWN completion state instead of relying on human passes.
builds_on: It builds directly on cycle 14's verification/audit foundation and cycles 10-13's closed action loop, adding mode-awareness: a single source of truth (fleet-mode.json) for WORK/MAINTENANCE/IDLE read by both dispatch and cockpit.
enables: Its 91.1% completion (24h, 1 intervention) - the highest in the convergence phase - stood up the fleet-mode infrastructure + auto-loop that cycles 16-17 expand into self-validation and steady-state measurement.

topic_source: explicit (same convergence umbrella as C15; per memory/archivist/topic-evolution.md)
why_now: Cycle 15 proved the fleet could self-track at 91.1% completion, so cycle 16 pushed the same convergence umbrella to a much larger scope - self-validation and end-to-end autonomous round execution - to test whether high autonomy survives real workload.
builds_on: It builds on cycle 15's fleet-mode single-source-of-truth + mode-aware dispatch, extending it into self-validation and full E2E autonomous rounds.
enables: The outcome was a warning sign for the convergence program - completion fell to 5.0% under ~79-goal scope (the documented scope>30 low-completion correlation) and human interventions regressed 1->2 - so cycle 17 narrowed to self-optimization + steady-state criteria rather than raw scope.
